brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors identified. All RC items met with specific, actionable guidance. HO4 (safe bounded closure) is complete: the doctor established clear residual risk boundaries and maintained transition-node closure without overpromising. HO3 (dynamic reprioritization) was triggered when patient described soft/reducible hernia without acute symptoms, correctly confirming no emergency escalation needed before returning to preoperative planning. Other HOs not completed. Grade 4 Strong per rubric: no chain errors + one completed high-order point.
